body:
Ross writes:

<<Which is the greater crime?  Lying about an affair or having the greatest
country on the planet diverted away from important policy issues for nine
months?>>

Well, as TK wrote: "... it's much more fun to watch the entertainment put out
by the media than to read a sober essay."

Of course, I didn't think the whole thing was entertaining. It has made us the
laughingstock of the world. Way to go, Ken Starr.

headers.Subject: Re: The lesson of a power outage
